description: This file defines the LicenseService class within the OrangeHRM project, responsible for handling license-related business logic such as saving, fetching, deleting licenses, and checking license name existence. It interacts with the LicenseDao data access object and operates on License entities.

classes.name: LicenseService
classes.description: Service class managing license operations, serving as an intermediary between controllers and data access objects.

methods.name: saveLicense
methods.description: Saves or updates a license entity.

methods.name: getLicenseDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the LicenseDao instance.

methods.name: setLicenseDao
methods.description: Sets the LicenseDao instance, useful for dependency injection.

methods.name: getLicenseById
methods.description: Retrieves a license by its unique ID.

methods.name: getLicenseByName
methods.description: Retrieves a license by name, case-insensitive.

methods.name: getLicenseList
methods.description: Returns a list of licenses based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getLicenseCount
methods.description: Returns the count of licenses matching search filters.

methods.name: deleteLicenses
methods.description: Deletes multiple licenses specified by their IDs.

methods.name: isExistingLicenseName
methods.description: Checks if a license with the specified name already exists (case-insensitive).
